**Observations from test image:**
- Close-up of mature, dried soybean pods on brown/dried stems
- Pods are uniformly dark brown, somewhat shriveled/dull
- No leaves visible; late-season appearance (R6-R8 stage)
- No visible mold, lesions, or chlorosis

**Key candidates:**
- **Diaporthe**: Late season (R6-R8), dry poorly developed pods, pycnidia on stems
- **Phomopsis**: Cracked, shriveled, dull seeds in pods
- **Charcoal_Rot**: Gray stems with microsclerotia (reference shows split gray stems — doesn't match)

The test image matches the late-season Diaporthe profile — dark brown, dry, poorly filled pods at near-harvest stage. Charcoal rot reference clearly doesn't match (gray split stems). The dried, darkened pod appearance aligns with Diaporthe pod and stem blight.
